sent_bad: The article is about **Jared Isaacman**, a tech billionaire and the founder/CEO of the Shift4 credit-card-processing company, who led the "Polaris Dawn" mission.

The crew of four: Isaacman, two SpaceX engineers (Anna Menon and Scott "Kidd" Poteet), and a former Air Force Thunderbird pilot (Sarah Gillis, a classically trained violinist who also performed in orbit).
